answer: In a canyon weather market, agents forecasting a gale must burn a fee in a scarce external asset before receiving one voting seat. The ledger binds each payment to one key and one round, rejecting reused receipts. A copper supplier running 1,000 aliases must therefore purchase and destroy 1,000 fees; moving funds between keys cannot recover spent admission costs. Set the fee against attainable rewards. Wealthy attackers can still pay, and honest newcomers also bear the cost.
